$description: Design DNA for the Aurora concept: one source of truth for color, type, space and motion. tokens.css mirrors these values as CSS custom properties.

rules: Enter with ease.out, exit with ease.in, travel with ease.inOut.
Big things move slow, small things move fast.
Stagger by reading order; never animate more than 3 groups at once.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: show the final state, keep the 3D scene static.
